scripts.text: I am in charge of interviews and arranging stories and my colleague is photographs. Veteran senior acts as a guide. As a magazine specializing in Adventure we go to cover dangerous places a lot.

scripts.text: Thank you so much. If he followed the veteran senior he might have gone to the ruined area. I saw his limpid eyes looking at the senior.

scripts.text: I will look around in this area. You don't have to bring him. Even though it's the Probationary period he should know how to work by himself! Just let me know where he is when you find him.

has to be delivered to Mugeosi of the Mechanical AI team.

scripts.text: I thought I told you don't have to come back. Anyway how did you get inside?
scripts.translation: 我不是說過不用回來嗎？算了，你是怎麼進來的？

scripts.text: We Bioengineers are doing all we can to produce food for the people inside the air-raid shelter.
scripts.translation: 我們生物工程師正在竭盡全力，為防空洞內的人們生產食物。

scripts.text: Sorry. Did you wait long? There are a lot of suspected infection patients as you can see..
scripts.translation: 抱歉，讓你久等了吧？你也看到了，疑似感染的病人很多...

scripts.text: Eh?! You didn't wait? That's strange? Did you cut in line? Cutting is bad.
scripts.translation: 咦？！你沒等嗎？真奇怪。你插隊了？插隊可不好。

scripts.text: As you know there are infectees who are suddenly showing strange phenomena..
scripts.translation: 你也知道，有些感染者會突然出現奇怪的症狀...

scripts.text: I don't see any problematic symptoms. Fortunate.
scripts.translation: 我沒發現什麼異常症狀。還好。

scripts.text: We are having trouble because of the suddenly convulsing patients.
scripts.translation: 那些突然抽搐的病人讓我們忙得不可開交。

scripts.text: Look here. My skin is getting crispy from not being able to sleep for days~
scripts.translation: 你看，我好幾天沒睡覺，皮膚都快乾裂了~

scripts.text: Hey. Aren't you an adventurer? You must be really strong.
scripts.translation: 喂，你是冒險者吧？一定很強。

scripts.text: Can you suppress that convulsing patient? I am counting on you.
scripts.translation: 能幫忙制伏那個抽搐的病人嗎？拜託你了。

scripts.text: You didn't get bit or scratched by the convulsing patient, did you?
scripts.translation: 你沒被那個抽搐的病人咬傷或抓傷吧？

scripts.text: Hmm~ I don't see any particular wounds.
scripts.translation: 嗯~ 我沒看到什麼特別的傷口。

scripts.text: Since I can't figure out the infection route...
scripts.translation: 既然還查不出感染途徑...

scripts.text: We have to prepare for a possible disaster...
scripts.translation: 我們就得為可能發生的災難做好準備...

scripts.text: Anyway, Adventurer~ Assuring and the best!
scripts.translation: 總之，冒險者就是可靠又能幹！

scripts.text: I haven't been that bewildered by simultaneously convulsing patients before..
scripts.translation: 以前從未遇到過這麼多病人同時抽搐的情況...

scripts.text: Lucky you were here to suppress it with ease.
scripts.translation: 幸好你在這裡，輕鬆就壓制住了。

scripts.text: I am sorry but can you report this to Fresa on your way? You know who Fresa is?
scripts.translation: 抱歉，你能順路把情況報告給弗雷薩嗎？你知道弗雷薩是誰吧？

scripts.text: It is a situation so I am asking you a favor.
scripts.translation: 情況緊急，只好拜託你了。

scripts.text: Take those patients down quickly! You're an adventurer!!
scripts.translation: 快把那些病人制伏！你可是冒險者啊！！

scripts.text: I am sorry but can you report this to Fresa on your way? This is a favor.
scripts.translation: 抱歉，能順路把情況報告給弗雷薩嗎？拜託你了。

scripts.text: Strange? How did you get in here? You should be prohibited access..
scripts.translation: 真奇怪，你是怎麼進來的？這裡應該禁止入內...

scripts.text: I'm fine. They're making a fuss for no reason.
scripts.translation: 我沒事。他們只是在小題大做。

scripts.text: I keep feeling sleepy for some reason. Is it because I'm sick?
scripts.translation: 不知道為什麼一直犯困。是因為生病了嗎？

scripts.text: My head feels blank.. Uh? Did you say something?
scripts.translation: 腦子一片空白...嗯？你剛才說什麼？

scripts.text: Ugh.. Feels like my whole body is cramped.
Urk.. I feel sick even though I didn't drink.
scripts.translation: 嘔...明明沒喝酒，卻覺得噁心。

scripts.text: Oh no is there a transfectant found in me..
scripts.translation: 糟了，我不會是感染者吧...

scripts.text: We used to deliver things like daily necessities or research tools here before the accident.
scripts.translation: 事故之前，我們曾在這裡運送生活必需品和研究工具。

scripts.text: Work that involved going out to other places a lot more even as a staff member here.
scripts.translation: 以前我們這裡的職員也經常要外出辦事。

scripts.text: What?! Is something going on? The Mechanicians and Facilities managers look busy.
scripts.translation: 什麼？出什麼事了？機械師和設施管理員看起來都很忙。

scripts.text: Yaa~ Did you try the grapes?
Isn't it great that we can grow fresh grapes in an underground evacuation facility like this?
scripts.translation: 能在這樣的地下避難所裡種出新鮮葡萄，不是很棒嗎？

scripts.text: Some people are suddenly attacking others.
scripts.translation: 有些人突然開始攻擊別人。

scripts.text: What in the hell is going on?
They were talking about it in the broadcast since yesterday so you know the gist of the situation, right?
scripts.translation: 從昨天起廣播就在說這件事，你應該知道大致情況吧？

scripts.text: The contaminant is getting to the interior of the air-raid shelter so the decision has been made to move all supplies to the uncontaminated zone Z-2 that the Chemical Substance Specialists found.
scripts.translation: 汙染物已經滲入避難所內部，因此決定把所有物資轉移到化學物質專家發現的未汙染區域Z-2。

scripts.text: There was a request to move the cargo with the Adventurers since the scrawny researchers won't be of help.
scripts.translation: 研究員們身材瘦弱，幫不上忙，所以有人提議讓冒險者來搬運貨物。

Oh! Wasn't there one more thing I requested? Did you send the message to the Mechanicians?
scripts.translation: 哦！我是不是還托你辦了件事？你給機械師傳話了嗎？

scripts.text: Ah.. What should I do.. Should I go since most of the goods are moved?
scripts.translation: 啊...我該怎麼辦...貨物大多搬完了，我是不是該親自去一趟？

scripts.text: If I leave it like this those idiots who know nothing outside of machines might do something with the precious components...
scripts.translation: 要是放任不管，那群只懂機器的白痴說不定會糟蹋那些珍貴零件...

scripts.text: What should we do? Should I go? Or do you want to go back?
scripts.translation: 怎麼辦？我去，還是你回去一趟？

scripts.text: Yeah? I guess the machine Warehouse is kind of far.
scripts.translation: 是嗎？看來機器倉庫確實挺遠的。

scripts.text: Since we're almost done here I will finish up quickly and go. This is compensation for the work.
scripts.translation: 這裡的工作差不多結束了，我趕緊收尾就過去。這是給你的報酬。

scripts.translation: 幸好我們提前撤進了避難所內部。

scripts.text: If we weren't able to evacuate..? We probably won't be here.
scripts.translation: 要是沒能及時撤離...我們恐怕就沒命了。

scripts.text: A while ago the Facilities managers were running around in haste.
scripts.translation: 剛才設施管理員們急匆匆地跑來跑去。

scripts.text: What in the world?! You ate fresh grapes? Why didn't I get to eat them? Why?
scripts.translation: 什麼？！你吃到新鮮葡萄了？為什麼我沒吃到？為什麼啊？

scripts.text: This place is sure quiet. Why you ask?
scripts.translation: 這裡真安靜。你問為什麼嗎？

scripts.text: Not many people come this far.
scripts.translation: 很少有人會走到這麼遠的地方。

scripts.text: Ah! Come on in. It seems there are a lot of visitors today because of the broadcast this morning.
scripts.translation: 啊！進來吧。看來今天早上的廣播引來了不少訪客。

scripts.text: You're here because Ernon sent you right?
I have received the item you have brought.
scripts.translation: 你帶來的東西我收到了。

scripts.text: Eh-? Are you taking it back? That is a lot of work.
scripts.translation: 咦？你要把東西拿回去？那可夠麻煩的。

scripts.text: You are going through a lot.
- You are carrying too many items to proceed with the quest -
scripts.translation: - 你攜帶的物品過多，無法繼續任務 -

scripts.text: Do you want finish your travels and

scripts.text: Your whole body becomes heavy and time seems to be passing faster around you.
scripts.translation: 你感到渾身沉重，周圍的時間似乎流逝得更快了。

scripts.text: A mysteriously intense driving energy can be felt from this device.
scripts.translation: 這個裝置散發出一股神秘而強烈的驅動力。

scripts.text: The surrounding distortion of time seems to be returning to normal.
scripts.translation: 周圍扭曲的時間似乎正在恢復正常。

scripts.text: This device's use cannot be figured out.
scripts.translation: 無法弄清楚這個裝置的用途。

scripts.text: I am not sure. Maybe you can ask Al over there?
scripts.translation: 我不太確定。也許你可以問問那邊的阿爾？

scripts.text: I mean the air cleaning unit you are moving now.
scripts.translation: 我說的是你現在正在搬的那臺空氣淨化裝置。

scripts.text: I made that. Isn't it awesome?
Ah!! You're the adventurer. You could check out the farm.
scripts.translation: 啊！你是冒險者吧？可以去農場看看。

scripts.text: Isn't the farm good because it's warm? I made the temperature control device there. Isn't it awesome?
scripts.translation: 農場很暖和，不錯吧？裡面的溫控裝置是我做的，厲害吧？

scripts.text: I am worried of the people suddenly attacking.
scripts.translation: 我擔心大家會突然互相攻擊。

scripts.text: Since we're already here should I make something like a patient suppression device?
scripts.translation: 既然都到這地步了，我是不是該做個能制伏病人的裝置？

scripts.text: I don't know why everybody is rejecting a device that can move heavy objects.
scripts.translation: 我不明白大家為什麼都反對製造搬運重物的裝置。

scripts.text: I should have made one when they were making new air cleaning units..
scripts.translation: 早知道他們要造新的空氣淨化裝置時，我就該做一個了...

scripts.text: Ugh.. I want to make something.
Who is that woman to conduct a headcount as if she's the leader?
scripts.translation: 那個女人是誰？怎麼像個領袖似的清點人數？

scripts.text: There wouldn't have been an explosion if there was no experiment the first place? Right?
scripts.translation: 要是一開始沒有那場實驗，不就不會發生爆炸了嗎？對吧？

scripts.text: I think the self-righteous and haggardly Fresa has changed.
scripts.translation: 那個自以為是、面容憔悴的弗雷薩好像變了。

scripts.text: She's become more warm compared to the past, right?
scripts.translation: 和以前相比，她待人更和善了，對吧？

scripts.text: Fresa has definitely changed a lot.
Today she is handing out grapes to people. In the past that would have been unimaginable.
scripts.translation: 今天她還在給大家發葡萄。放在以前，簡直不可想像。

scripts.text: Why is that Fresa acting like the leader alone but still hasn't taken measures?
scripts.translation: 弗雷薩為什麼像個領袖似的獨斷專行，卻遲遲不採取措施？

scripts.text: Measures need to taken about the convulsing patients. Are you going to cover this up like in the past?
scripts.translation: 必須處理那些抽搐的病人。你們還想像以前那樣把事情瞞下來嗎？

scripts.text: I should have known when she tried to half-ass things.
scripts.translation: 她之前敷衍了事的時候，我就該想到會出問題。

scripts.text: I really don't like self-righteous and hypocritical Fresa.
scripts.translation: 我真討厭弗雷薩那副自以為是、虛偽的樣子。

scripts.text: Ugh.. It seems you are unlucky as well.
scripts.translation: 唉...看來你的運氣也不怎麼樣。

scripts.text: Don't you think this place is trying to exploit us Adventurers?
scripts.translation: 你不覺得這裡在壓榨我們這些冒險者嗎？

scripts.text: The Cafeteria food is good though.
scripts.translation: 不過食堂的飯菜倒是不錯。

scripts.text: Grapes were served on the side today.
I like grapes. I want to eat more.
scripts.translation: 我喜歡葡萄，還想再多吃點。

scripts.text: A friend I made here is confined in the temporary clinic. They found a transfectant or something.
scripts.translation: 我在這裡交的一個朋友被關進了臨時診所。他們說他感染了什麼東西之類的。

scripts.text: To us adventurers a healthy body is an asset.
scripts.translation: 對我們冒險者來說，健康的身體就是本錢。

scripts.translation: 今天真奇怪。嘿，你也看到那邊那個神秘裝置了嗎？

scripts.translation: 我今天光這句話就說了30遍了，可門口根本沒有什麼裝置。

scripts.text: I am itching for an adventure but safety outside isn't confirmed so don't think of going outside.
scripts.translation: 我也很想出去冒險，但外面的安全狀況還沒確認，別想著出去了。

scripts.text: A while I ago I couldn't stop the Chemical Substance Specialists from going outside.
scripts.translation: 剛才我沒能攔住那些化學物質專家出門。

scripts.text: Seeing how they didn't return, they must be dead, right?
scripts.translation: 他們一直沒回來，肯定已經死了吧？

scripts.translation: 啊，空氣淨化裝置不該放在這裡。

scripts.text: If my memory is correct, you have to deliver them to Zones C-0, F-1, F-2, I-0, Z-0.
scripts.translation: 如果我沒記錯，你得把裝置送到C-0、F-1、F-2、I-0和Z-0區。

scripts.text: Haa- I have been cleaning the Control room for several days now
scripts.translation: 唉——我已經清理控制室好幾天了。

scripts.text: This place cannot be organized no matter how I much organize it. I guess we should just use it for storage.
scripts.translation: 這裡怎麼整理都收拾不乾淨。我看還是當倉庫用吧。

scripts.text: Come on in. Welcome to the Warehouse.
This is not the control room.
Patient~ That chair is quite high.. doesn't your head ache?
scripts.translation: 病人~那把椅子挺高的...你不覺得頭疼嗎？

scripts.text: Why does he say he has a cramp? The other patients didn't have that problem.
scripts.translation: 他為什麼說自己抽筋了？其他病人可沒這個問題。

scripts.text: Argh- I told you not to scribble on the floor while pretending to sleep.
scripts.translation: 啊——我告訴過你，假裝睡覺的時候不要在地板上塗鴉。

scripts.text: You ran around the elephant trunk thirty times so you must be sick. Claiming he can't feel dizziness. Quite the bluffer.
scripts.translation: 你繞著象鼻跑了三十圈，肯定是生病了。還說自己一點都不暈，真能吹。

scripts.text: Ah geez! There is no other issues yet but why is he saying he's dizzy?
scripts.translation: 哎呀！目前還沒發現其他問題，可他為什麼說自己頭暈？

scripts.text: So what do you mean!! Where does it hurt!!
scripts.translation: 你到底在說什麼！！哪裡疼！！

scripts.text: What do you mean nothing is wrong, your face has gone purple.
scripts.translation: 你說沒事，但你的臉都發紫了。

scripts.text: It seems we can harvest grape tree number 1 without problems. What a relief.
scripts.translation: 看來1號葡萄樹可以順利收穫了。真是鬆了口氣。

scripts.text: My heart sank when the Mechanicians destroyed a tree..
scripts.translation: 機械師毀掉一棵樹時，我的心都沉了下去...

scripts.text: The soil grape tree number 2 is in seems to be lacking nutrition.
scripts.translation: 2號葡萄樹所在的土壤好像缺少養分。

scripts.text: We need to prepare fertilizer to provide the soil more nutrition.
scripts.translation: 我們得準備些肥料，給土壤補充養分。

scripts.text: I worried because a lot of weird stuff was growing around grape tree number 3.
scripts.translation: 3號葡萄樹周圍長了很多奇怪的東西，害我擔心了好一陣。

scripts.text: It seems the harvest will have no problem.
Grape tree number 4 has no particular problem.
Nutrition state good. Harvest state good.
scripts.translation: 養分狀況良好，收成狀況也良好。

scripts.text: The nutrition of grape tree number 5 is too good.
That doesn't mean there will be a higher harvest yield..
scripts.translation: 不過，這不代表收成會更好...

scripts.text: There is a Memory Record somebody is recording.
scripts.translation: 有人正在錄製記憶記錄。

scripts.text: Ah ah- One two three test- test-
To distinguish survival days in the air-raid shelter, today will be designated Explosion Day 1 after the experiment explosion.
scripts.translation: 為了記錄大家在避難所裡的生存天數，今天定為實驗爆炸後的第1天。

scripts.text: Everybody fell into panic after seeing the outside situation on the monitor after the explosion.
scripts.translation: 爆炸後，大家從監視器上看到外面的情況，全都陷入了恐慌。

scripts.text: But chief researcher Dr. Fresa calmly consoled everybody and checked how many survived.
scripts.translation: 但首席研究員弗雷薩博士冷靜地安撫了大家，並清點了倖存者人數。

scripts.text: The final number of survivors including adventurers seems to be 326.
scripts.translation: 包括冒險者在內，最終倖存者似乎共有326人。

scripts.text: The camera showing outside was damaged in the afternoon. It seems we cannot see the situation outside anymore.
scripts.translation: 下午，用來監視外面的攝像頭壞了。看來我們再也看不到外面的情況了。

scripts.text: There is no more recorded content.
A witch hunt against the director and chief researcher Fresa began.
scripts.translation: 針對總監兼首席研究員弗雷薩的批鬥開始了。

scripts.text: My opinion is different. The research and experiment was conducted under her direction but this is an accident.
scripts.translation: 我的看法不同。研究和實驗雖然都是在她的主持下進行的，但這只是一次事故。

scripts.text: If not Fresa, they would have made somebody else to blame.
scripts.translation: 就算不是弗雷薩，他們也會找別人來背鍋。

scripts.text: But she is handling it in a dignified manner despite concerns.
scripts.translation: 儘管眾人對她有諸多質疑，她仍從容應對。

scripts.text: She says problem solving is more important than blame and is checking assignments of survivors before the accident.
scripts.translation: 她說解決問題比追究責任更重要，正在重新確認事故發生前倖存者的工作安排。

scripts.text: Fresa.. She naturally became the leader of the survivors.
scripts.translation: 弗雷薩...她自然而然地成了倖存者們的領袖。

scripts.text: There was no vote of sorts, but nobody is complaining about her being the leader.
scripts.translation: 雖然沒有進行投票，但沒有人對她擔任首領提出異議。

scripts.text: The day before she had a briefing on the situation of the total survivors.
scripts.translation: 前一天，她聽取了全體倖存者的情況簡報。

scripts.text: Other than specialists the assignments of survivors such as cafeteria staff, janitors, gardeners, distribution directors, health professionals, adventurers caught in the accident have been assessed.
scripts.translation: 名化學物質專家此外，我們還統計了其他倖存者的分工，包括食堂員工、清潔工、園丁、配送主管、醫護人員，以及意外捲入事故的冒險者。

scripts.text: Everybody's work has been decided based on Fresa's briefing the day before.
scripts.translation: 所有人的工作都根據弗雷薩前一天的簡報安排妥當。

scripts.text: It was decided that researchers including myself know nothing much research and must continue our lives in the air-raid shelter under the guidance of those who have technical skill needed for survival.
scripts.translation: 包括我在內的研究員對許多事情都不甚瞭解，因此決定由掌握生存所需技能的人帶領我們，繼續在避難所裡生活。

scripts.text: First the Chemical Substance Specialists and Facilities managers started to install Air Contamination Gauge Sensors in the air-raid shelter.
scripts.translation: 首先，化學物質專家和設施管理員開始在避難所內安裝空氣汙染監測感測器。

scripts.text: After evaluating that oxygen levels were low the Mechanicians have started to assemble Air cleaning units.
scripts.translation: 確認氧氣含量偏低後，機械師們開始組裝空氣淨化裝置。

scripts.text: Lora, a former cafeteria employee was consulted on the important problem of food.
scripts.translation: 食物是個大問題，於是大家請教了前食堂員工洛拉。

scripts.text: We assessed that about 40 days of survival is possible based on the food in the warehouse and the number of survivors.
scripts.translation: 根據倉庫裡的食物儲備和倖存者人數，我們估算這些食物大約能支撐40天。

scripts.text: This prompted the Bioengineers to cultivate plants that can self-produce.
scripts.translation: 於是，生物工程師開始培育能夠自行繁殖的植物。

scripts.text: Other miscellaneous assignments were issued under Fresa's direction.
scripts.translation: 弗雷薩還安排了其他各種雜務。

scripts.text: I don't know the details but the air pollution level outside of the shelter was measured.
scripts.translation: 具體情況我不清楚，只知道有人測量了避難所外的空氣汙染程度。

scripts.text: According to the Chemical Substance Specialists the situation is hopeless.
scripts.translation: 化學物質專家說，外面的情況已經無可挽回。

scripts.text: It seems life in the air-raid shelter has to continue longer. Just can quietly keep working..
scripts.translation: 看來我們還得在避難所裡待很久。只能繼續默默工作...

scripts.text: After silently working for several days the Bioengineers have good news.
scripts.translation: 生物工程師們默默工作了幾天後，終於帶來了好訊息。

scripts.text: They have succeeded in artificially germinating a plant that can self-produce.
scripts.translation: 他們成功人工培育出了一種能夠自行繁殖的植物。

scripts.text: Fortunately the air-raid shelter has a warehouse spacious enough to grow plants in.
scripts.translation: 幸好避難所裡有個足夠寬敞的倉庫，可以用來種植。

scripts.text: It seems we can forget about our food problem now.
scripts.translation: 看來食物問題總算解決了。

scripts.text: A small problem has occurred in the air-raid shelter. The air cleaning units made in the beginning are broken.
scripts.translation: 避難所裡出了點小問題：最初製造的空氣淨化裝置壞了。

scripts.text: Fortunately there will be no problem maintaining oxygen concentration levels thanks to the air cleaning units the Mechanicians made without approval.
scripts.translation: 幸好機械師們未經批准就製造了新的空氣淨化裝置，因此氧氣濃度仍能維持在安全水平。

scripts.text: They are too heavy so adventurers were deployed because nobody else is able to move them.
scripts.translation: 新裝置太重，其他人都搬不動，只能派冒險者去搬。

scripts.text: There is no more recorded content.
Today is the first harvest of the grape tree cultivated by the Bioengineers.
scripts.translation: 今天是生物工程師培育的葡萄樹首次收穫的日子。

scripts.text: Although there was a small problem of the Mechanicians destroying one grape tree
scripts.translation: 雖然機械師弄壞了一棵葡萄樹，出了點小插曲，

scripts.text: The air-raid shelter residents are throwing a small party to celebrate the successful harvest.
scripts.translation: 避難所的居民還是辦了個小型派對，慶祝成功收穫葡萄。

scripts.text: There is no more recorded content.
Chemical Substance Specialists and some Adventurers sick of living in the air-raid shelter have left the shelter to measure the air.
scripts.translation: 一些受夠了避難所生活的化學物質專家和冒險者離開避難所，去測量外面的空氣。

scripts.text: They have not returned by evening.
scripts.translation: 直到傍晚，他們都沒有回來。

scripts.text: Was the freedom of outside better than the life in the dark air-raid shelter?
scripts.translation: 難道外面的自由，比在黑暗避難所裡的生活更好嗎？

scripts.text: After midnight the remaining Chemical Substance Specialists assessed that they were dead and everybody had a brief moment of silence.
scripts.translation: 午夜過後，剩下的化學物質專家認定他們已經遇難，大家為他們默哀了片刻。

scripts.text: A dark rumor is going around the shelter.
scripts.translation: 避難所裡開始流傳一個不祥的傳聞。

scripts.text: There is a rumor that a contaminant from the outside has invaded the air-raid shelter because of the people who left a while ago.
scripts.translation: 有人說，之前離開的人把外面的汙染物帶進了避難所。

scripts.text: Is it because of the contaminant? There are patients who suddenly convulse and attack others.
scripts.translation: 是汙染物造成的嗎？有些病人會突然抽搐，還會攻擊別人。

scripts.text: Under the leader Fresa's decision, everybody was checked and those found with transfectants were quarantined in the temporary clinic.
scripts.translation: 在首領弗雷薩的決定下，所有人都接受了檢查；體內發現感染體的人被隔離在臨時診所。

scripts.text: There is no more recorded content.
The rumor in the air-raid shelter has come true.
scripts.translation: 避難所裡的傳聞成真了。

scripts.text: The remaining Chemical Substance Specialists have confirmed that the contaminant is eroding into the air-raid shelter
scripts.translation: 剩下的化學物質專家確認，汙染物正在侵入避難所內部。

scripts.text: And Fresa and experts have started taking measures.
scripts.translation: 弗雷薩和專家們已經開始採取措施。

scripts.text: The invading contaminant will not stop.
scripts.translation: 入侵的汙染物沒有停止擴散。

scripts.text: It has been decided to move all equipment and necessities to the less contaminated Zone Z-2
scripts.translation: 大家決定把所有裝置和必需品都轉移到汙染較輕的Z-2區。

scripts.text: And facility managers have started to install a partition in Zone Z-0 to prevent the contaminant from coming in further.
scripts.translation: 設施管理員們開始在Z-0區安裝隔離牆，阻止汙染物繼續侵入。

scripts.text: There is no more recorded content.
The mechanical device thrown on the floor cannot be determined if it is still operable.
scripts.translation: 扔在地上的機械裝置，不知道還能不能用。

scripts.text: There is a Memory Record somebody is recording.
scripts.translation: 有人正在錄製記憶音盤。

scripts.text: Oh- Is this a memory record? Does it work? Oh it works. Works! Should I try it since I'm bored?
scripts.translation: 哦，這是記憶音盤嗎？還能用嗎？好像能用。真能用！反正閒著也是閒著，要不聽聽？

scripts.text: My name is Maso an Adventurer traveling the world. Today is 4th day of entering the air-raid shelter? 3rd day? The vibe here is weird and hard to adjust to.
scripts.translation: 我叫馬索，是個周遊世界的冒險者。今天是進避難所的第4天？還是第3天？這裡氣氛怪怪的，真讓人不習慣。

scripts.text: Verus city has Adventurers amongst its original population but the treatment towards Adventurers is strangely good.
scripts.translation: 維魯斯城的原住民中也有冒險者，不過他們對冒險者好得有些反常。

scripts.text: The mood is that Adventurers are people caught up in an uncontrollable accident and need to be treated well.
scripts.translation: 大家似乎覺得，冒險者只是意外捲入這場無法控制的事故，應該好好對待。

scripts.text: As an Adventurer who eats and plays as much as he works, I cannot stand the itching for action. Urgh
scripts.translation: 我這種平時吃吃喝喝、到處冒險的傢伙，真受不了這股無處發洩的勁。唉。

scripts.text: Is today day 6? Details aren't told to Adventurers so I am not sure but the people of Verus city seem very gloomy.
scripts.translation: 今天是第6天嗎？冒險者得不到太多訊息，我也不確定。不過維魯斯城的人看起來都很沮喪。

scripts.text: The Adventurer's blood is boiling and wanting to explore places but there isn't much to do.
scripts.translation: 我這個冒險者渾身熱血沸騰，恨不得出去探索，可這裡根本沒什麼事可做。

scripts.text: I looked around the air-raid shelter but whoever designed it has not one artistic hair on him.
scripts.translation: 我在避難所裡四處看了看，設計這裡的人恐怕一點藝術細胞都沒有。

scripts.text: It is no fun to keep looking at the same hallways and same room lay outs.
scripts.translation: 每天看著同樣的走廊和房間佈局，實在無聊。

scripts.text: Is today day 21? The Verus City people look happy to have solved the food problem.
scripts.translation: 今天是第21天嗎？食物問題解決了，維魯斯城的人看起來很高興。

scripts.text: It is cute to see the mild looking researchers going around cheering and screaming.
scripts.translation: 看著那些平時溫文爾雅的研究員到處歡呼尖叫，還挺可愛的。

scripts.text: The 30th night but because it's always dark I don't really know if it's night or day. I just ate supper so it must be night.
scripts.translation: 今天是第30個夜晚。不過這裡總是黑漆漆的，我也分不清白天黑夜。剛吃過晚飯，應該是晚上吧。

scripts.text: Today I moved the really heavy air cleaning units made by the Mechanicians with the other Adventurers.
scripts.translation: 今天我和其他冒險者一起，搬動了機械師們製造的那些非常沉重的空氣淨化裝置。

scripts.text: The air-raid shelter is so large that I had no idea where they were but thanks to that I became friends with some of the Adventurers, especially Castle and Blat.
scripts.translation: 避難所太大了，我根本不知道他們把裝置搬去了哪裡。不過這次倒讓我結識了幾位冒險者，尤其是卡斯爾和布拉特。

scripts.text: By the way the Mechanicians seem to have mental problems. They make a ruckus for not being able to make machines and got dragged out by the guards.
scripts.translation: 順便一提，機械師們好像有點不對勁。他們因為沒法制造機器而大吵大鬧，最後被衛兵拖走了。

scripts.text: The Mechanicians are definitely going to cause trouble someday.
scripts.translation: 機械師們遲早會惹出麻煩。

scripts.text: There is no more recorded content.
scripts.translation: 沒有更多的錄音內容了。

scripts.text: Today is day 32 and I worked on the grape harvest.
scripts.translation: 今天是第32天，我去幫忙採收葡萄了。

scripts.text: I ate fresh grapes and since I don't have anything to do anything to do, I'm going to sleep early.
scripts.translation: 我吃了新鮮葡萄，反正也沒什麼事可做，就早點睡吧。

scripts.text: Ah.. the grape was good, I want it again. Did they say harvest was possible once every 2 weeks?
scripts.translation: 啊...葡萄真好吃，還想再吃。聽說每兩週就能收穫一次？

scripts.text: There is no more recorded content.
scripts.translation: 沒有更多的錄音內容了。

scripts.text: Today is the 38th day of being in the shelter and there is a fuss since the morning.
scripts.translation: 今天是待在避難所裡的第38天，一大早就鬧鬨鬨的。

scripts.text: This morning the recruited Adventurers to join the Chemical Substance Specialists for an investigation outside the air-raid shelter, many volunteered despite the dangers.
scripts.translation: 今天早上，他們招募冒險者和化學物質專家一起去避難所外調查。儘管有危險，還是有很多人自願參加。

scripts.text: I am of the belief danger should be avoided but my friends Castle and Blat volunteered.
scripts.translation: 我覺得還是避開危險比較好，可我的朋友卡斯爾和布拉特都自願去了。

scripts.text: Well I understand that they were sick of living in the shelter for a while.
scripts.translation: 不過我也明白，他們在避難所裡待膩了。

scripts.text: They have not returned past the afternoon. Verus City leader Fresa has concluded that the people who left are dead.
scripts.translation: 他們直到下午都沒回來。維魯斯城的領袖弗雷薩認定，離開的人已經遇難。

scripts.text: Everybody had a moment of silence at dawn. They were good people so it is sad to part like this.
scripts.translation: 天亮時，大家為他們默哀了一會兒。他們都是好人，想到就此分別，真讓人難過。

scripts.text: Is it since the morning of the 40th day? There is a mysterious infectious disease going around the shelter.
scripts.translation: 是從第40天早上開始的嗎？避難所裡好像出現了一種神秘的傳染病。

scripts.text: A few people have suddenly attacked those near them and convulsed
scripts.translation: 有些人突然開始抽搐，還攻擊身邊的人。

scripts.text: And Adventurers have been deployed to suppress the convulsing people because a lot of the weak researchers are wounded.
scripts.translation: 許多體弱的研究員受了傷，於是派冒險者去制伏那些抽搐的人。

scripts.text: There is a rumor saying a contaminant came in because of the people who went outside the shelter a while go.
scripts.translation: 有人傳言，之前離開避難所的人把汙染物帶了進來。

scripts.text: There is no more recorded content.
scripts.translation: 沒有更多的錄音內容了。

scripts.text: Lunch during day 44 the air-raid shelter leader Fresa gathered the Adventurers and had a presentation.
scripts.translation: 第44天午餐時，避難所領袖弗雷薩召集冒險者，向大家說明了情況。

scripts.text: The rumor has been confirmed true and a safety partition will be built in Zone Z-0
scripts.translation: 傳聞已經得到證實，他們決定在Z-0區建一道隔離牆。

scripts.text: A decision has been made to move necessities to Zone Z-2 tomorrow and I heard they need the help of Adventurers.
scripts.translation: 他們決定明天把必需品轉移到Z-2區，聽說需要冒險者幫忙。

scripts.text: I have to work tomorrow so I am doing to sleep early.
scripts.translation: 我明天還得工作，今晚早點睡。

scripts.text: There is no more recorded content.
scripts.translation: 沒有更多的錄音內容了。

scripts.text: I don't know what brings you here but please don't touch anything.
scripts.translation: 我不知道你來這裡做什麼，不過請別碰任何東西。

scripts.text: I haven't finished checking the stock and it would be annoying if anything went missing.
scripts.translation: 我還沒盤點完庫存，要是少了什麼東西就麻煩了。

scripts.text: You're an adventurer. You don't have to deliver air cleaners here.
scripts.translation: 你是冒險者吧？不用把空氣淨化裝置送到這裡。

scripts.text: It's a warehouse anyway. The independent air circulation system is enough.
scripts.translation: 反正這裡是倉庫，有獨立的空氣迴圈系統就夠了。

scripts.text: Aahh- Looking after the warehouse is annoying.
There is nobody to rotate my shift
You're not here to ambush me right? It's alright if not.
scripts.translation: 你不是來偷襲我的吧？不是就好。

scripts.text: Are you here to move items?
The goods in this warehouse should not be today I think? From what I know today we are moving necessities first.
scripts.translation: 今天不該搬這個倉庫裡的貨物吧？我記得今天應該先轉移生活必需品。

scripts.text: I don't know the reason, but Fresa assigned me here.
scripts.translation: 我也不知道原因，不過弗雷薩把我派到了這裡。

scripts.text: I always wondered why I was assigned here but now I think I know the reason.
scripts.translation: 我一直納悶為什麼把我派來這裡，現在大概明白了。

scripts.text: It is to watch if the Mechanicians make useless things.
scripts.translation: 原來是要監視機械師們有沒有又在搗鼓沒用的東西。

scripts.text: The Mechanicians occasionally want to make something.
scripts.translation: 機械師們偶爾會想造點什麼。

scripts.text: My job is to stop them.
scripts.translation: 我的工作就是攔著他們。

scripts.text: I hear patients these days are convulsing and attacking the people around them?
scripts.translation: 我聽說最近有些病人會抽搐，還會攻擊身邊的人？

scripts.text: The Mechanician constantly convulse saying they want to make something so it's not weird to me.
scripts.translation: 機械師們老嚷嚷著要做東西，抽搐起來我倒也不覺得奇怪。

scripts.text: The convulsion of Mechanicians are reaching extremes.
scripts.translation: 機械師們抽搐得越來越厲害了。

scripts.text: They are convulsing so much I may need to call back up.
scripts.translation: 他們抽搐得這麼厲害，我可能得叫增援了。

scripts.text: We are seeing if there are hazardous substances within the air-raid shelter according to emergency protocol.
scripts.translation: 我們正按照緊急協議，排查避難所內是否存在危險物質。

scripts.text: You want to know how many Chemical Substance Specialists there are? Go to Karsten then. Should be here somewhere.
scripts.translation: 想知道化學物質專家有多少人？去找卡斯滕問問吧，他應該就在附近。

scripts.text: This next room is temporarily being used by the Chemical Substance Specialist.
scripts.translation: 下一間房暫時由化學物質專家使用。

scripts.text: We tightly hid away dangerous things but don't touch anything just in case.
scripts.translation: 危險物品都被我們嚴嚴實實地藏好了，不過以防萬一，還是別碰任何東西。
卡斯滕給了我一些葡萄。

scripts.text: How fresh and tasty it was.
My colleagues left the air-raid shelter to investigate and haven't come back.
scripts.translation: 我的同事們離開避難所去調查，到現在還沒回來。

scripts.text: It was concluded they are dead but are they really all dead? I want to see my colleagues.
scripts.translation: 大家都認定他們已經遇難了，可他們真的全都死了嗎？我想再見見我的同事。

scripts.text: We are working to find a solution for the contaminant.
scripts.translation: 我們正在設法解決汙染問題。

scripts.text: I found this while looking around the air-raid shelter
scripts.translation: 我在避難所裡四處檢視時發現了這個...

scripts.text: but there is a lot of this on the wall. What can it be?
scripts.translation: 可牆上到處都是這種東西。到底是什麼？

scripts.text: I have been investigating this for 30 days already but I do not know what it is.
scripts.translation: 我已經調查了30天，還是不知道這是什麼。

scripts.text: I am too proud to ask somebody.
scripts.translation: 我又拉不下臉去問別人。

scripts.text: I have been investigating this for 32 days already but I do not know what it is.
scripts.translation: 我已經調查32天了，還是不知道這是什麼。

scripts.text: Ugh what to do.. Should I just ask somebody?
scripts.translation: 唉，該怎麼辦...要不還是問問別人？

scripts.text: I have been investigating this for 40 days already.
My pride won't let me quit now.
scripts.translation: 我的自尊心不允許我現在放棄。

scripts.text: 45 days have passed since I started investigating this unknown thing.
scripts.translation: 調查這個未知的東西，已經過去45天了。

scripts.text: How did I come to investigate this?
scripts.translation: 我當初為什麼會開始調查這個來著？
